item.title: CBD vs Southbank — Which Melbourne Suburb Wins?
item.description: The CBD and Southbank face each other across the Yarra River, connected by a handful of bridges and separated by fundamentally different approaches to city living. The CBD is Melbourne’s commercial and cultural core — noisy, dense, and endlessly convenient. Southbank is its residential counterpart — quieter streets, river views, and a surprising amount of arts and culture. If you want to live in the absolute centre of Melbourne, the choice comes down to which side of the Yarra suits you.
